name: Fathom
tagline: AI meeting partner that records and summarises calls
description: Fathom records and transcribes calls and produces instant AI summaries, with a free plan and paid plans for individuals and teams.
features: Unlimited recordings and transcriptions on the Free plan
Choice of bot-free (beta) or bot capture
Clips, playlists and search across calls
useCases: Recording and summarising sales or client calls
Searching what was said across past calls
strengths: A free-forever plan with unlimited recordings
A 90-day guarantee is listed on every plan
limitations: The pricing page did not make clear which listed price is monthly and which is annual
Some features are marked limited use without saying which plan they apply to

free.details: Free forever: unlimited recordings and transcriptions, bot-free (beta) or bot capture, instant AI call summaries, clips, playlists and search across calls.

plans.name: Premium
plans.note: $20 and $16 per user per month are both shown; the page does not say which is monthly billing and which is annual

plans.name: Team
plans.note: $19 and $15 per user per month are both shown, 2 users minimum; which is monthly and which is annual is not stated

plans.name: Business
plans.note: $34 and $25 per user per month are both shown, 2 users minimum; which is monthly and which is annual is not stated

pricing.regional: Prices were shown with a '$' sign and no currency code. A toggle says annual billing saves 25% or more.

verification.notes: Product active. The page shows Free $0; Premium $16; Team $15 and Business $25 per user/month (Team and Business need 2 users); Enterprise by sales. The pricing toggle (Monthly / Annually, save 25%+) could not be switched, so the page text does not say which billing period these figures belong to; an earlier check also saw $20, $19 and $34. Kept partial.
